title: 2.1.33 Flip It with !
description: Use the ! operator to flip a boolean inside an if condition. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.1.8: 'Combining Conditions', Example 2.1.11: Flipping a condition with !

steps.title: Declare a boolean
steps.instructions: Create a variable called isRaining and set it to true or false.

steps.title: Flip it with !
steps.instructions: Write an if statement whose condition is !isRaining. Inside the block, log a message about walking to school. After the if, log isRaining and !isRaining on separate lines to see the flip.

requirements.title: if condition is !isRaining and logs
requirements.description: if statement's condition is !isRaining, and console.log runs inside the block
